topic: Trump simultaneously claims Iran war victory and pushes for diplomacy amid munitions depletion
tweet1: Trump told reporters yesterday he'll resume bombing Iran if talks fail — while his own Pentagon scrambles to replace depleted interceptors that can't stop the next drone wave.
tweet2: @AFP captured Trump on Air Force One: optimistic about a deal, but warned strikes continue if diplomacy fails. Meanwhile @SenateDems shows Sen. Van Hollen stating the US has "depleted our interceptors."
tweet3: @cgtnamerica reports Trump "brushes off concerns of depleted ammunition." But @thehill's poll shows 8 in 10 Americans say the war's been harder than expected. The gap between his confidence and material reality keeps growing.
tweet4: You can't negotiate from strength when your missile defense is running on fumes. Either Trump doesn't know the Pentagon's inventory status, or he's betting Iran doesn't either. Which scenario worries you more?
